statement: ∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (a : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (J : ℕ → Set ℝ), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (J i)) → (∀ t ∈ YuiI, c ≤ ∑' i, (J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => a i) t) → c ≤ ∑' i, a i * MeasureTheory.volume (J i)
proof:
intro c a J hJ hc
have hI : MeasurableSet YuiI := measurableSet_Icc
have hm (i : ℕ) : Measurable ((J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => a i)) :=
  measurable_const.indicator (hJ i)
calc
  c = ∫⁻ _ : ℝ in YuiI, c := by
    simp [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const, YuiI, Real.volume_Icc]
  _ ≤ ∫⁻ t : ℝ in YuiI, ∑' i, (J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => a i) t := by
    apply MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono_ae
    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem hI] with t ht
    exact hc t ht
  _ = ∑' i, ∫⁻ t : ℝ in YuiI, (J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => a i) t :=
    MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum (fun i => (hm i).aemeasurable)
  _ ≤ ∑' i, a i * MeasureTheory.volume (J i) := by
    apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
    intro i
    rw [MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_indicator (hJ i), MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const]
    exact mul_le_mul_left' (MeasureTheory.measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left) _

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
        (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
          (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
    ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YuiContent s δ E < ∞) →
      ∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (a : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (J : ℕ → Set ℝ),
        (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasurableSet (J i)) →
          (∀ t ∈ YuiI, c ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), (J i).indicator (fun x => a i) t) →
            c ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), a i * MeasureTheory.volume (J i)
